title: Grateful Dead Live at Recreation Hall, UC Davis on 1982-03-14
lineage: Dat Sony PCM-R500 > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/44.1k  1 DVD FLAC Transfer By Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Decent sound‑board capture of an unremarkable show that slips in a brief Phil‑birthday “Happy Birthday” space.
ai_review.review: The sbd source is complete but far from pristine – listeners note occasional clarity issues and prefer the audience mix. Musically the concert is restrained; the second set’s song list looks promising on paper, yet the band never really goes into extended jams, aside from a short birthday‑themed space around the two‑minute mark.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate (3‑star) review; it points to an average performance and a fair‑quality soundboard, leading to a blended rating just above the midpoint.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Not the best board – some muddiness and limited clarity; reviewers prefer the audience version for overall listening pleasure.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second‑set setlist looks good on paper but the band stays restrained, avoiding big jams.

band_member_comments.Phil: A brief "Happy Birthday" space early in the show, likely honoring Phil Lesh (birthday March 15).
